This is a senior-level backend engineering role on a new skunkworks team at Grafana Labs, building the storage layer for an AI-native data intelligence platform that gives AI agents governed access to enterprise data and context. The work covers a multi-tenant database with both OLAP and transactional capabilities — ingestion, query planning, distributed query execution, data and storage formats, with separation of compute and storage across multiple clouds. The core stack centers on a systems language like Go, C++, or Rust, plus distributed systems, query engines, table formats and catalogs, cloud-native infrastructure, and observability tooling.
